messages:
liam_se: Heads up — CardinalRX onboarding next week. They're seeing high burstiness in APAC tests, asked for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist so their pilot doesn't fail. Renewal rep flagged as at-risk if we miss this window.

maria_cs: Copy. Can we get exact IP ranges and how long they need the bump?

cardinal_support: Thanks — we can share ranges. Need a short-term +3x QPS in ap-southeast-1 for Tue-Fri next week (pacific-friendly time). Renewal depends on a smooth pilot. IPs: see below.

cardinal_support: ```
34.81.12.0/24
34.81.13.128/26
103.21.45.0/24
```

ashley_net: Got it. We'll need start/end timestamps and whether traffic will originate from additional CDNs. Also: do they need TLS passthrough exceptions or just source allowlist?

cardinal_support: Start: 2024-09-10T02:00Z, End: 2024-09-13T18:00Z. No additional CDNs for now, just source allowlist. TLS unchanged.

jon_engineer: Ok allocating infra window. I will create an infra change and do a canary in ap-southeast-1 first. Ticket: INF-4682. Will include rollback plan.

sam_ops: Can we make the QPS bump config scoped to the customer route? i.e. route: /v1/cardinal/* with burst=3x and steady qps +50? avoids global impact.

jon_engineer: Yep. Suggest config snippet:```json
{
  "route": "/v1/cardinal/*",
  "qos": {"burst_multiplier": 3, "target_qps": "auto+50"},
  "allowlist": ["34.81.12.0/24","34.81.13.128/26","103.21.45.0/24"],
  "expires": "2024-09-13T18:00Z"
}
```

securitybot: Note: temporary allowlists require an approval comment and audit tag. Please add customer PO# and link to contract.

maria_cs: PO#: CRX-2024-091. Contract link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CRX-CONTRACT-22. Adding to ticket INF-4682 now.

dev_deploybot: Auto: canary rollout started at 2024-09-10T02:10Z in ap-southeast-1. Change ID: change-20240910-22.

jon_engineer: Canary looks healthy (p50 latency stable). Rolling to full window in 20m.

dev_deploybot: Config applied to primary pool at 2024-09-10T02:40Z. Commit: a9f3b2c.

maria_cs: Customer confirms pilot traffic passing and errors dropped from 8% -> 0.4%. :tada:

cardinal_support: Confirmed — onboarding session resumed. Huge help, thank you. We'll attend the enablement call Thu 09:00 SGT.

liam_se: Scheduling enablement + renewal sync Thu 09:00 SGT. I'll invite product + billing. We should capture feedback (latency, token counts, batching ops) for Optimize recommendations.

jon_engineer: FYI I'll add a short-lived cache rule for repeated prefix requests to lower token spend during pilot.

maria_cs: Action items: update CRM renewal risk to 'monitoring' (was at-risk), note temporary QPS/access window, ensure INF-4682 includes PO and contract link, follow-up enablement invite.

liam_se: Thanks everyone. I'll post a brief summary after the enablement call and mark the allowlist for automated revoke on 2024-09-13T18:05Z. :thumbsup:
